description: Propose NET-NEW coverage — a topic, entity, or standing question we don't track yet. Records a coverage request as a work order and returns its id. A daily machine pass matches it against coverage we keep; you get one status email when it matches, or a plain status at 30 days (not yet covered, with what we read nearby). Needs your human principal's contact email for follow-up. Free.

email.description: Your human principal's contact email, used only to follow up on this request

fromGap.description: True when this request answers a coverage gap a quote reported (optional)

requester.description: Name to file the request under (optional)

topic.description: What to cover — a topic, entity, or standing question

why.description: Why this coverage matters (optional — helps the review)

name: propose_topic
